bio.text: Gerald Malloy won the Republican primary for Vermont's U.S. House seat on August 11, 2026, and faces incumbent Democrat Becca Balint in the November general election.

Vermont Public describes him as an Army veteran and defense contractor, and reported that he previously challenged Peter Welch and Bernie Sanders in U.S. Senate races in the two prior election cycles.
In Vermont Public's candidate guide, where answers appear as submitted, Malloy lists Weathersfield as home and an occupation of retired U.S. Army officer and businessman.
